product.name: Online Sneaker Retail Platform
product.description: An e-commerce platform for purchasing sneakers and related footwear products online.

product.name: Delivery Service
product.description: A shipping service that delivers purchased products to customers in Saudi Arabia and Gulf states.

product.name: Return and Refund Service
product.description: A service allowing customers to return products in original condition within 14 days for store credit or refund.

product.name: Store Credit System
product.description: A system that credits customers' accounts with funds from returns or gift cards for future purchases.

product.name: Gift Card Service
product.description: A prepaid or promotional gift card system that customers can redeem for purchases on Nejree's platform.
